landscape_decision_reason: Primary publication describes executable SNPPar software operating on SNP alignments and phylogenetic trees.
canonical_anchor_title: SNPPar: identifying convergent evolution and other homoplasies from microbial whole-genome alignments

landscape_decision_reason: Primary publication describes executable SubRecon software operating on protein sequence alignments and phylogenies.
canonical_anchor_title: SubRecon: ancestral reconstruction of amino acid substitutions along a branch in a phylogeny
